reason: The free first visit and the gated Baby Nook with a cap on how many kids are in at once speak to my worry. I'd try it, and if it's calm I'd come back a couple times a month on a weekday, since it's an easy drive in from Fruitland.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? A gated nook and a headcount limit sound good, but I won't believe it until I see it on a real busy afternoon. Also $13 a visit adds up fast on my budget.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing on the free visit that the under-2 area stays separate and calm, with older kids kept out of it.
